_comment: Copy to config.json (git-ignored) or ~/.config/terminal-toys/config.json. Every key is optional; anything omitted keeps the tool's default.

deployments._comment: token: create one at Account Settings -> Tokens. The Vercel CLI's session is not used - it expires within hours. Keep this file chmod 600.

github._comment: token: a CLASSIC PAT with repo + read:org - fine-grained tokens reach only one org each, and this board spans several. The API is called directly, so the gh CLI is not needed. Keep this file chmod 600.

linear._comment: Personal API key: Linear Settings -> Security & access -> Personal API keys. Nothing needs selecting; exclude_teams is for dropping a noisy automated intake. Keep this file chmod 600.

pr._comment: Reuses github.token. Each source is one GitHub search; results are pooled and de-duplicated, because GitHub search has no OR. @mine expands to every org you belong to plus your own account.
